settle AFTER the dropdown becomes visible but BEFORE selecting it - the Simulation Setup panel keeps fetching/overwriting its own fields for a short window after mount, and a select/fill that lands inside that window gets silently reverted moments later (confirmed live, reproducible: StepID 995's waitForSelector alone still let ITER_04 lose Random Number Seed=Fixed back to Clock and Number of Simulations Run back to the default 10000, roughly 11s after the fill - the fetch was still in flight when 1010/1020 ran). Waiting it out here, before any field is touched, makes the automation's selection win deterministically instead of racing an unpredictable async overwrite - same fix shape as the proven settle-after-Calculate pattern used elsewhere in this codebase.
